summary: Deploy document-agent with high availability under $100/month
rationale: Serve qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct with the upstream llama.cpp engine (no build) in staging, minimum 2 replicas for availability and a cap of 3 replicas scaled on pending requests. At 1 GiB per replica the estimate is 3 x 1 GiB x $0.0084/GiB-h x 730 h = $18.40/month, well under the $100 budget together with the existing workloads.

files.content:
# Proposed by aiplatform propose: HA document agent on the upstream llama.cpp engine.
name: document-agent
model: qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct
engine: llamacpp-server
cpu: 1
memory: 1Gi
environment: staging
port: 8000
autoscaling:
  min: 2
  max: 3
  metric: queue
  target: 2
env: {}

risks: Two replicas need 2 GiB of node memory; on the kind laptop pause other add-ons first
Deploy with `aiplatform deploy --dir services/document-agent --target gitops` after merge
